detail.longDescription: I want a check to validate my Pull Request title. I want the check to be managed by the organisation to enforce it in every repository. I added the following workflow to the organisation's .github repository and added it as a required workflow to my branch ruleset: on: pull_request: types: - opened - edited - synchronize - reopened jobs: test: runs-on: self-hosted steps: - run: echo "${{ github.event.action }}" However, the workflow will only get triggered when a PR is opened, reopened or synchronized but never on edited (for example when I change the PR's title or description). If the workflow is implemented locally inside the repository it works and is also triggered upon editing the PR's title or description. I have seen bug reports on GitHub for this issue back in 2021/2023, but they have been marked as closed. Any workarounds available?
